# Camelot Flows

> Solo web atelier of Alexandru (Alex) Buzi in Chișinău, Moldova. Fixed-price websites for
> local service businesses — set up to be found on Google, built to convert, and owned
> outright by the client. No agency, no account managers, no middlemen: one builder with
> direct access. Site content is available in English, Romanian, and Russian.

## Services

- Website builds: WordPress / WooCommerce / custom static builds, conversion-first design
- Local SEO setup: Google Business Profile optimization, on-page local SEO, LocalBusiness schema
- Merlin AI automation: lead routing, client intake, tier-1 support agents (n8n, Make, Claude API)
- Optional Hosting & Care plan: hosting, SSL, backups, updates — sold as technical work performed,
  never as a traffic or ranking promise

## Pricing (fixed, one-time — no required monthly fees)

- Start one-pager: from €390
- Found full build: €690–€1,200, fixed to page count
- Custom premium website: from €1,200

## Client work

- Timberkids (timberkids.md) — WooCommerce store for a handmade kids' furniture maker,
  launched in under two weeks; trilingual (WPML), product personalization
- First Line Garage Door (firstlinegarage.com) — lead-gen site for a Chicago-area garage
  door service, delivered three days ahead of deadline; click-to-call, LocalBusiness + FAQ schema

## Areas served

Moldova and Romania first; EU and US remotely. Everything delivered remotely with direct
builder access.
